title: The last spade wins an open trick

feedback.title: Trump wins an open trick
feedback.summary: You hold no Diamonds, and as the last card in this trick any trump beats every card already played, locking in a trick your target still needs.
points: No trump has appeared yet this trick, and a trump always beats a non-trump card regardless of rank.
You act last, so no other card can be added to challenge it.
The target needs one more trick from the two remaining; this one is guaranteed.

feedback.title: Skipping a guaranteed trick
feedback.summary: Discarding lets the queen of Diamonds win instead, giving away this guaranteed trick and leaving the two of Spades as your only card for the unresolved final trick.
points: The two of Spades cannot be saved for later; it is your only remaining card after this trick.
Passing on a guaranteed win now leaves the target depending on an uncertain final trick.
Whether trump would still win the final trick is not known from here; this trades a certain trick now for an unresolved one later.

author_notes: Second reviewed play scenario: recognizing a void suit and a guaranteed trump win when acting last. Winner resolution is not implemented; the app does not compute this automatically yet.
